request: Replace the bundled Python MarkItDown sidecar with a much smaller native Rust document-to-Markdown sidecar while preserving HivemindOS's 16-format and security contracts.

entries.note: Reused the stripped LTO single-binary release profile.
Adapted locked Cargo build, target staging, and version verification.
Translated extension dispatch into the bounded HivemindOS JSONL protocol without retaining OfficeMD runtime crates.
Adapted Outlook message field and body extraction.
Adapted in-memory workbook loading and sheet iteration for XLS and XLSX.
Adapted the typed HTML conversion API for HTML and EPUB chapters.
